method: Walked 480 m along geometry:lhc-tunnel-ring from the same ATLAS interaction-point reference (ring index 1) in the direction of decreasing ring index (toward the Point 8/LHCb side, the '81' sector, confirmed by insertion-8's 'LHCb' tag), per SND@LHC's sourced siting '480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point, in the TI18 tunnel' (arXiv:2210.02784 abstract). Same anchor-precision reasoning as geometry:ti12-faser-point.
name: TI18 tunnel, SND@LHC location (derived point)

summary.plain: A derived point 480 m from the ATLAS interaction point, along the LHC ring toward Point 8, marking SND@LHC's approximate location in the TI18 tunnel.
